ux.name: Smooth Scroll
ux.description: Anchor links should scroll smoothly to target section
ux.do: Use scroll-behavior: smooth on html element

ux.name: Sticky Navigation
ux.description: Fixed nav should not obscure content
ux.do: Add padding-top to body equal to nav height
ux.dont: Let nav overlap first section content

ux.name: Active State
ux.description: Current page/section should be visually indicated
ux.do: Highlight active nav item with color/underline
ux.dont: No visual feedback on current location

ux.name: Back Button
ux.description: Users expect back to work predictably
ux.do: Preserve navigation history properly

ux.name: Deep Linking
ux.description: URLs should reflect current state for sharing
ux.do: Update URL on state/view changes

ux.name: Breadcrumbs
ux.description: Show user location in site hierarchy
ux.do: Use for sites with 3+ levels of depth

ux.name: Excessive Motion
ux.description: Too many animations cause distraction and motion sickness
ux.do: Animate 1-2 key elements per view maximum

ux.name: Duration Timing
ux.description: Motion duration depends on distance complexity platform and user context
ux.do: Use shared motion tokens and test that feedback stays responsive
ux.dont: Present 150-300ms or any cutoff as a universal requirement

ux.name: Reduced Motion
ux.description: Respect user's motion preferences
ux.do: Check prefers-reduced-motion media query

ux.name: Loading States
ux.description: Show feedback during async operations
ux.do: Use skeleton screens or spinners
ux.dont: Leave UI frozen with no feedback

ux.name: Hover vs Tap
ux.description: Hover effects don't work on touch devices
ux.do: Use click/tap for primary interactions
ux.dont: Rely only on hover for important actions

ux.name: Continuous Animation
ux.description: Infinite animations are distracting
ux.do: Use for loading indicators only

ux.name: Transform Performance
ux.description: Some CSS properties trigger expensive repaints
ux.do: Use transform and opacity for animations

ux.name: Easing Functions
ux.description: Easing should match how an element changes speed and purpose
ux.do: Use deceleration when arriving acceleration when leaving and linear for constant-rate progress
ux.dont: Reject linear easing even for steady rotation or progress

ux.name: Z-Index Management
ux.description: Stacking context conflicts cause hidden elements
ux.do: Define z-index scale system (10 20 30 50)

ux.name: Overflow Hidden
ux.description: Hidden overflow can clip important content
ux.do: Test all content fits within containers

ux.name: Fixed Positioning
ux.description: Fixed elements can overlap or be inaccessible
ux.do: Account for safe areas and other fixed elements

ux.name: Stacking Context
ux.description: New stacking contexts reset z-index
ux.do: Understand what creates new stacking context
ux.dont: Expect z-index to work across contexts

ux.name: Content Jumping
ux.description: Images badges validation text and skeleton replacements can shift nearby content when they update
ux.do: Reserve appropriate space or keep async states in a stable content-driven container
ux.dont: Insert compact text or media without a layout strategy

ux.name: Viewport Units
ux.description: 100vh can be problematic on mobile browsers
ux.do: Use dvh or account for mobile browser chrome

ux.name: Container Width
ux.description: Content too wide is hard to read
ux.do: Limit max-width for text content (65-75ch)
ux.dont: Let text span full viewport width

ux.name: Touch Target Size
ux.description: Touch target guidance depends on platform and web context
ux.do: Use 44pt on iOS and 48dp on Android; for web use the separate WCAG Target Size rule
ux.dont: Treat one unit or minimum as universal across platforms

ux.name: Touch Spacing
ux.description: Adjacent touch targets need adequate spacing
ux.do: Minimum 8px gap between touch targets

ux.name: Gesture Conflicts
ux.description: Custom gestures can conflict with system
ux.do: Avoid horizontal swipe on main content

ux.name: Tap Delay
ux.description: 300ms tap delay feels laggy
ux.do: Use touch-action CSS or fastclick

ux.name: Pull to Refresh
ux.description: Accidental refresh is frustrating
ux.do: Disable where not needed

ux.name: Haptic Feedback
ux.description: Tactile feedback improves interaction feel
ux.do: Use for confirmations and important actions

ux.name: Focus States
ux.description: Keyboard focus, including controls inside a modal, needs a visible indicator
ux.do: Use a visible focus ring on every interactive control, including modal controls

ux.name: Hover States
ux.description: Visual feedback on interactive elements
ux.do: Change cursor and add subtle visual change
ux.dont: No hover feedback on clickable elements

ux.name: Active States
ux.description: Show immediate feedback on press/click
ux.do: Add pressed/active state visual change

ux.name: Disabled States
ux.description: Clearly indicate non-interactive elements
ux.do: Reduce opacity and change cursor

ux.name: Loading Buttons
ux.description: Prevent double submission during async actions
ux.do: Disable button and show loading state

ux.name: Error Feedback
ux.description: Users need to know when something fails
ux.do: Show clear error messages near problem

ux.name: Success Feedback
ux.description: Confirm successful actions to users
ux.do: Show success message or visual change

ux.name: Confirmation Dialogs
ux.description: Prevent accidental destructive actions
ux.do: Confirm before delete/irreversible actions

ux.name: Color Contrast
ux.description: Text must be readable against background
ux.do: Minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text

ux.name: Color Only
ux.description: Don't convey information by color alone
ux.do: Use icons/text in addition to color

ux.name: Alt Text
ux.description: Images need text alternatives
ux.do: Descriptive alt text for meaningful images

ux.name: Heading Hierarchy
ux.description: Screen readers use headings for navigation
ux.do: Use sequential heading levels h1-h6
ux.dont: Skip heading levels or misuse for styling

ux.name: ARIA Labels
ux.description: Interactive elements need accessible names
ux.do: Add aria-label for icon-only buttons

ux.name: Keyboard Navigation
ux.description: Web users need complete keyboard navigation with visible focus on every operable control
ux.do: Keep tab order aligned with visual order and test every action without a pointer
ux.dont: Keyboard traps or illogical tab order

ux.name: Screen Reader
ux.description: Content should make sense when read aloud
ux.do: Use semantic HTML and ARIA properly

ux.name: Form Labels
ux.description: Inputs must have associated labels
ux.do: Use label with for attribute or wrap input

ux.name: Error Messages
ux.description: Error messages must be announced
ux.do: Use aria-live or role=alert for errors

ux.name: Skip Links
ux.description: Allow keyboard users to skip navigation
ux.do: Provide skip to main content link
ux.dont: No skip link on nav-heavy pages

ux.name: Image Optimization
ux.description: Large images slow page load
ux.do: Use appropriate size and format (WebP)

ux.name: Lazy Loading
ux.description: Load content as needed
ux.do: Lazy load below-fold images and content

ux.name: Code Splitting
ux.description: Large bundles slow initial load
ux.do: Split code by route/feature

ux.name: Caching
ux.description: Repeat visits should be fast
ux.do: Set appropriate cache headers

ux.name: Font Loading
ux.description: Web fonts can block rendering
ux.do: Use font-display swap or optional

ux.name: Third Party Scripts
ux.description: External scripts can block rendering
ux.do: Load non-critical scripts async/defer

ux.name: Bundle Size
ux.description: Large JavaScript slows interaction
ux.do: Monitor and minimize bundle size

ux.name: Render Blocking
ux.description: CSS/JS can block first paint
ux.do: Inline critical CSS defer non-critical

ux.name: Input Labels
ux.description: Every input needs a visible label
ux.do: Always show label above or beside input

ux.name: Error Placement
ux.description: Each invalid field needs an inline error connected to that field
ux.do: Show a specific error below the input and reference it with aria-describedby
ux.dont: Show only a top-level error without identifying each invalid field

ux.name: Inline Validation
ux.description: Validate as user types or on blur
ux.do: Validate on blur for most fields

ux.name: Input Types
ux.description: Use appropriate input types
ux.do: Use email tel number url etc

ux.name: Autofill Support
ux.description: Help browsers autofill correctly
ux.do: Use autocomplete attribute properly

ux.name: Required Indicators
ux.description: Mark required fields clearly
ux.do: Use asterisk or (required) text

ux.name: Password Visibility
ux.description: Let users see password while typing
ux.do: Toggle to show/hide password

ux.name: Submit Feedback
ux.description: Confirm form submission status
ux.do: Show loading then success/error state

ux.name: Input Affordance
ux.description: Inputs should look interactive
ux.do: Use distinct input styling
ux.dont: Inputs that look like plain text

ux.name: Mobile Keyboards
ux.description: Show appropriate keyboard for input type
ux.do: Use inputmode attribute

ux.name: Mobile First
ux.description: Design for mobile then enhance for larger
ux.do: Start with mobile styles then add breakpoints

ux.name: Breakpoint Testing
ux.description: Test at all common screen sizes

ux.name: Touch Friendly
ux.description: Mobile layouts need touch-sized targets
ux.do: Increase touch targets on mobile

ux.name: Readable Font Size
ux.description: Text must be readable on all devices
ux.do: Minimum 16px body text on mobile

ux.name: Viewport Meta
ux.description: Set viewport for mobile devices
ux.do: Use width=device-width initial-scale=1

ux.name: Horizontal Scroll
ux.description: Avoid horizontal scrolling
ux.do: Ensure content fits viewport width

ux.name: Image Scaling
ux.description: Images should scale with container
ux.do: Use max-width: 100% on images

ux.name: Table Handling
ux.description: Tables can overflow on mobile
ux.do: Use horizontal scroll or card layout

ux.name: Line Height
ux.description: Adequate line height improves readability
ux.do: Use 1.5-1.75 for body text

ux.name: Line Length
ux.description: Long lines are hard to read
ux.do: Limit to 65-75 characters per line

ux.name: Font Size Scale
ux.description: Consistent type hierarchy aids scanning
ux.do: Use consistent modular scale

ux.name: Font Loading
ux.description: Fonts should load without layout shift
ux.do: Reserve space with fallback font

ux.name: Contrast Readability
ux.description: Body text needs good contrast
ux.do: Use darker text on light backgrounds

ux.name: Heading Clarity
ux.description: Headings should stand out from body
ux.do: Clear size/weight difference

ux.name: Loading Indicators
ux.description: Loading feedback should match the expected wait and avoid flashing for near-instant work
ux.do: Follow platform and component guidance; preserve layout focus and accessible busy status
ux.dont: Apply one timing threshold to every operation or leave long waits unexplained

ux.name: Empty States
ux.description: Guide users when no content exists
ux.do: Show helpful message and action

ux.name: Error Recovery
ux.description: Help users recover from errors
ux.do: Provide clear next steps

ux.name: Progress Indicators
ux.description: Show progress for multi-step processes
ux.do: Step indicators or progress bar

ux.name: Toast Notifications
ux.description: Transient messages for non-critical info
ux.do: Auto-dismiss after 3-5 seconds

ux.name: Confirmation Messages
ux.description: Confirm successful actions
ux.do: Brief success message

ux.name: Truncation
ux.description: Handle long content gracefully
ux.do: Truncate with ellipsis and expand option

ux.name: Date Formatting
ux.description: Use locale-appropriate date formats
ux.do: Use relative or locale-aware dates

ux.name: Number Formatting
ux.description: Format large numbers for readability
ux.do: Use thousand separators or abbreviations

ux.name: Placeholder Content
ux.description: Show realistic placeholders during dev
ux.do: Use realistic sample data

ux.name: User Freedom
ux.description: Users should be able to skip tutorials
ux.do: Provide Skip and Back buttons

ux.name: Autocomplete
ux.description: Help users find results faster
ux.do: Show predictions as user types

ux.name: No Results
ux.description: Dead ends frustrate users
ux.do: Show 'No results' with suggestions

ux.name: Bulk Actions
ux.description: Editing one by one is tedious
ux.do: Allow multi-select and bulk edit

ux.name: Disclaimer
ux.description: Users need to know they talk to AI
ux.do: Clearly label AI generated content

ux.name: Streaming
ux.description: Waiting for full text is slow
ux.do: Stream text response token by token

ux.name: Gaze Hover
ux.description: Elements should respond to eye tracking before pinch
ux.do: Scale/highlight element on look

ux.name: Depth Layering
ux.description: UI needs Z-depth to separate content from environment
ux.do: Use glass material and z-offset

ux.name: Auto-Play Video
ux.description: Autoplaying media consumes data and creates motion barriers
ux.do: Prefer click-to-play; provide pause and captions; stop off-screen and honor reduced motion
ux.dont: Auto-play high-resolution loops without pause or captions

ux.name: Asset Weight
ux.description: Heavy 3D/Image assets increase carbon footprint
ux.do: Compress and lazy load 3D models

ux.name: Feedback Loop
ux.description: AI needs user feedback to improve
ux.do: Thumps up/down or 'Regenerate'

ux.name: Motion Sensitivity
ux.description: Parallax/Scroll-jacking causes nausea
ux.do: Honor prefers-reduced-motion and present the final readable state without parallax or scroll-jacking

ux.name: Focus Not Obscured (Minimum)
ux.description: WCAG 2.2 AA requires keyboard focus to remain at least partially visible
ux.do: Offset sticky UI with scroll-padding and dismiss or move persistent overlays
ux.dont: Let headers footers banners or chat widgets fully cover focus

ux.name: Focus Not Obscured (Enhanced)
ux.description: WCAG 2.2 AAA requires keyboard focus to remain fully visible
ux.do: Keep the entire focused component unobscured by author-created content
ux.dont: Present this enhanced AAA criterion as an AA requirement or allow persistent UI to hide any part of focus

ux.name: Focus Appearance
ux.description: WCAG 2.2 AAA defines minimum area and contrast for focus indicators
ux.do: Use an indicator at least as large as a 2 CSS px perimeter with 3:1 state contrast
ux.dont: Present this enhanced AAA criterion as an AA requirement or use a thin low-contrast outline

ux.name: Dragging Movements
ux.description: WCAG 2.2 AA requires a single-pointer alternative for author-controlled drag operations
ux.do: Add buttons menus or tap-to-move controls and retain keyboard operation
ux.dont: Make dragging the only way to reorder resize or select

ux.name: Target Size (Minimum)
ux.description: WCAG 2.2 AA requires 24 CSS px pointer targets or an applicable exception
ux.do: Use at least 24 by 24 CSS px or verify spacing equivalent inline user-agent or essential exceptions
ux.dont: Assume native 44pt or 48dp guidance defines web conformance

ux.name: Consistent Help
ux.description: WCAG 2.2 A requires repeated help mechanisms to stay in the same relative order
ux.do: Keep contact self-help and automated help in consistent locations
ux.dont: Move help controls to different locations on each page

ux.name: Redundant Entry
ux.description: WCAG 2.2 A avoids requiring the same information twice in one process
ux.do: Auto-populate prior values or let users select previously entered information
ux.dont: Ask users to retype the same address or account data without necessity

ux.name: Accessible Authentication (Minimum)
ux.description: WCAG 2.2 AA says authentication must not depend only on a cognitive function test unless an exception applies
ux.do: Allow password managers and paste; offer passkeys OAuth or another non-cognitive method
ux.dont: Block paste or require manual OTP transcription with no alternative

ux.name: Auto-Rotating Content Controls
ux.description: Auto-rotating content needs user control
ux.do: Provide previous next and play/pause; stop on focus or hover and when reduced motion is requested
ux.dont: Auto-advance slides without a stop control

ux.name: Focusable Error Summary
ux.description: An error summary for failed validation complements inline field errors and must be easy to find by keyboard and screen reader users
ux.do: Place it at the top of the form; move focus to its heading or container after failed submit; link each item to its invalid field; retain inline errors
ux.dont: Replace inline errors with a visual-only summary or move focus on every blur

ux.name: Heading Line Balance
ux.description: Short multi-line headings may use balanced wrapping as a progressive visual heuristic
ux.do: Bound the measure and test natural-wrap fallback across widths fonts and locales
ux.dont: Promise an exact final line or insert blanket nonbreaking spaces or hardcoded br tags

ux.name: Long Token Wrapping
ux.description: URLs identifiers and user content must not force horizontal overflow
ux.do: Use overflow-wrap anywhere and let flex or grid text children shrink
ux.dont: Apply word-break break-all to all prose

ux.name: Text Reflow and Spacing
ux.description: Text must remain available at narrow widths zoom and user spacing overrides
ux.do: Use fluid sizes content-driven height and unitless line height
ux.dont: Clip text in fixed-width or fixed-height boxes

ux.name: Essential Text Truncation
ux.description: Headings actions errors safety text and distinguishing names need complete access
ux.do: Wrap stack resize or provide a visible full-detail path
ux.dont: Clamp essential meaning only to make cards uniform

ux.name: Compact Label Semantics
ux.description: Badges communicate state while chips or tags represent values or actions
ux.do: Choose static or interactive markup from the label's meaning and ownership
ux.dont: Make every pill clickable or encode status with color alone

ux.name: Chip Collection Reflow
ux.description: Filter chips and editable value collections must preserve labels when space or text size changes
ux.do: Wrap the collection or use an operable +n disclosure for hidden overflow values
ux.dont: Force all chips into one clipped row or hide overflow values

ux.name: Compact Label Overflow
ux.description: A badge chip or pill label should stay whole on one line when practical and disclose unavoidable truncation
ux.do: Bound only unpredictable values; use nowrap with a shrinkable label; expose full text to keyboard pointer and touch users
ux.dont: Let one compact label wrap to a second line or use a hover-only tooltip

ux.name: Compact Control Semantics
ux.description: Interactive chips need a native role accessible name state keyboard operation and visible focus
ux.do: Prefer a button and expose pressed or selected state that matches the visible label
ux.dont: Use a clickable div or reveal the only action on hover

ux.name: Contextual Live Badge Updates
ux.description: Async badge and count changes should announce a meaningful contextual status without moving focus
ux.do: Use one appropriate atomic status message such as 3 items in cart
ux.dont: Announce a bare number or make every badge a competing live region

ux.name: Cancellable State Transitions
ux.description: Rapid compact-control changes can interrupt an in-flight transition
ux.do: Cancel or replace prior motion; set the final semantic state directly and handle cancellation cleanup
ux.dont: Depend on animationend or transitionend for required state correctness

ux.name: IME Composition Enter
ux.description: Korean (한글) Japanese and Chinese IME composition can use Enter to confirm text rather than submit a chat message or search
ux.do: Cancel the default action of handled Enter before guarding isComposing or legacy keyCode 229; preserve Shift+Enter and modifier policy; ignore repeats; retain a submit button for virtual keyboards
ux.dont: Send or clear text on every Enter keydown or submit from compositionend
